name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension with Strap Support
description: An overhead dumbbell triceps extension where a strap or pad is used to support the upper arm. The support eliminates upper arm drift under fatigue and ensures pure elbow extension throughout the set. This technique is used by competitive bodybuilders for maximum isolation.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Overhead Dumbbell Extension with Strap Support in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Overhead Dumbbell Extension with Strap Support.
steps: Step 1: Set up with upper arm resting on pad or against strap at ear level.
Step 2: Hold dumbbell overhead with elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Step 3: Extend elbow to press dumbbell overhead, upper arm against support.
Step 4: Lower slowly behind head maintaining contact with support.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Moving upper arm away from support
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
